name: Fertőboz (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Fertőboz (a red and blue shield with an eagle, a bunch of grapes, a chapel, reeds and a fish) above the name FERTŐBOZ in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
